reference: This time tomorrow he will be adding motion to every single button.
sk: Zajtra o takomto čase bude pridávať pohyb ku každému tlačidlu.
cz: Zítra touhle dobou bude přidávat pohyb ke každému tlačítku.
acceptable: {this time tomorrow|at this time tomorrow|tomorrow at this time} he will be adding {motion|movement|animation} to {every single|every|each} button.
He will be adding {motion|movement|animation} to {every single|every|each} button {this time tomorrow|at this time tomorrow|tomorrow at this time}.

mistakes.text: This time tomorrow he will add motion to {every single|every} button.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Dej, ktorý bude v danom čase práve prebiehať, vyjadruje Future Continuous: „will be adding“, nie „will add“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Děj, který bude v danou dobu právě probíhat, vyjadřuje Future Continuous: „will be adding“, ne „will add“.
mistakes.feedback_en: An action in progress at a set future time needs Future Continuous: “will be adding”, not “will add”.

mistakes.text: This time tomorrow he {adds|is adding} motion to {every single|every} button.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Dej, ktorý bude v danom čase práve prebiehať, vyjadruje Future Continuous: „will be adding“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Děj, který bude v danou dobu právě probíhat, vyjadřuje Future Continuous: „will be adding“.
mistakes.feedback_en: An action in progress at a set future time needs Future Continuous: “will be adding”.

mistakes.text: This time tomorrow he will {be add|adding} motion to {every single|every} button.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Future Continuous sa tvorí „will be“ + -ing: „will be adding“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Future Continuous se tvoří „will be“ + -ing: „will be adding“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Future Continuous is “will be” + -ing: “will be adding”.

mistakes.text: {Tomorrow in this time|In this time tomorrow} he will be adding motion to {every single|every} button.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Zajtra o takomto čase“ je „this time tomorrow“, bez „in“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Zítra touhle dobou“ je „this time tomorrow“, bez „in“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The time phrase is “this time tomorrow”, without “in”.

mistakes.text: This time tomorrow he will be adding motion to {every single|every} buttons.

source_issues: SK/CZ have no 'single' (každému tlačidlu); 'every' and 'each' accepted.
